assumed_inputs.description: Remaining elapsed days until launch-quality content is ready at the cutoff
assumed_inputs.research_task: Determine Remaining elapsed days until launch-quality content is ready at the cutoff
assumed_inputs.rationale: Representative remaining elapsed days from cutoff to content readiness. Exact internal state unobserved. Joint branch assumption chosen to represent on-time, brief-slip, longer rework or terminal paths; not a measured duration.

assumed_inputs.description: Remaining elapsed days until at least one qualifying US platform is certified and distributable
assumed_inputs.research_task: Determine Remaining elapsed days until at least one qualifying US platform is certified and distributable
assumed_inputs.rationale: Representative remaining elapsed days to the first qualifying platform becoming distributable; includes certification, preload and distribution readiness in parallel with content work. No internal certification milestone observed. Digital-first boxed codes reduce disc-manufacturing dependence, not software-readiness risk.

assumed_inputs.description: Announced release date that passes without indication of delay; never if delayed before passing
assumed_inputs.research_task: Determine Announced release date that passes without indication of delay; never if delayed before passing
assumed_inputs.rationale: Applies only when an applicable announced release date has passed with no indication of delay. Modeled at next US Eastern midnight. Never means this alternative route does not trigger in the scenario, not that full release is impossible.

gaps.note: A complete declaration is not proof of adequate evidence or a correct dependency structure.

limitations: Dates, durations, dependencies and scenario weights are supplied, not inferred from evidence.
Each scenario is one joint assignment. No independent sampling or equal weighting is implicit.
Unweighted scenario counts are not probabilities. Weighted scenarios require a declared exhaustive partition.
Durations are elapsed days of 86400 seconds. Resource contention and working-day calendars are not modeled.
Sensitivity is a declared-input stress test, not a confidence interval or an estimate of research value.
Retrieved text is represented by accurate paraphrases, not a full-page archive.
Live pages and search indexing can be stale; no verified internal build, completion, certification or gold milestone was found.
Two Newswire article opens returned zero extractable lines; the official product page and Take-Two releases supplied accessible corroboration.
Rockstar, its parent Take-Two, and storefronts may share one publisher schedule; agreement is not independent multiplication of evidence.
Costs and model calls are unmetered. Workflow numeric zero counters mean unreported usage, not zero cost.
No calibrated delay reference class was fitted; weights and milestone timings are subjective judgments.
